newsitem.title: USA: Huntington Bancshares to acquire Bank/Winter Park.
newsitem.headline: Huntington Bancshares to acquire Bank/Winter Park.

text.p: Huntington Bancshares Inc said Thursday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Bank of Winter Park for stock in Huntington. Terms of the acquistion were not disclosed.
The Bank of Winter Park, is a closely-held bank with four branches in the the Greater Orlando, Florida area, and had total assets of approximately $90 million at March 31.
Upon completion of this transaction, Huntington said it will operate 47 banking offices with approximately $1.8 billion in assets in the Central and West Coast areas of Florida.
The acquisition will be accounted for as a purchase and is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 1997. The purchase is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.
Huntington, based in Columbus, Ohio, had $21.6 billion in assets and 355 branches in six states at March 31.
